📝 Once per shot before its keys (D77): generate the cinematography sheet through the imagegen tool (frame at the start and end of the move, top-down staging plan with the camera path and leading line, emitter, D74 hue pair, figure on-screen height in heads) from the actors' model sheets and the owner's Composition cards, measure it, and write v3/layouts/<shot>.json as the camera contract the key sheet is drawn at and the render study is measured against (C25).
